title: Ranking sociodemographic, health behavior, prevention, and environmental factors in predicting neighborhood cardiovascular health: A Bayesian machine learning approach
summary: Bayesian Additive Regression Trees rank census-tract sociodemographic, behavioral, prevention, and environmental predictors of cardiovascular-health outcomes using combined CDC, Census, and EPA datasets.
ai_technology: Model fit/explained variance and predictor rankings are validated within aggregated neighborhood data; ecological association does not establish individual or causal effects.
organization: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
